candidate_selection.rule: Use the final completed S1 arm that passed its advance gate. Never choose a checkpoint from the inference outcomes.

stages.promotion: Keep every point. Advance only Pareto points plus any retained negative boundary.
Keep all points, including non-monotonic 3200 and zero-step refiner.
Evaluate frozen Pareto points on Official-100; do not search the grid on Official-100.
A pooled win fails if the high-block outlier materially regresses.
Appendix ceiling only; never supports a deployable claim.
Blocked until M6 validates a selector beyond p2b on untouched proposals.

training.comment: Inference-only frontier; use one frozen S1 checkpoint.

budget_ledger.oracle_compute_rule: Charge every generated draw whose output or score is inspected.
budget_ledger.single_sample_quality_threshold: Exact Trinity d192 on the same NFE/refiner point.
budget_ledger.equal_quality_threshold: Frozen anchor quality before evaluating higher draw counts.

claim_gates.same_inference_win: Both cost and V_rel are lower than the exact anchor at identical NFE, refiner, draws, selector and legalizer budget.
claim_gates.equal_quality_efficiency_win: A paired case-clustered interval excludes zero for the total-budget saving at a frozen anchor quality threshold.
claim_gates.absolute_budget_win: Both metrics beat the strongest exact same-protocol anchor with parameters, training, NFE, refiner, draws, selector, EDA response and wall time disclosed.
claim_gates.required_guard: Legalized feasibility remains 1.0; high-block and Official-100 negative points remain in the ledger.
forbidden: using Official-100 outcomes to choose the grid
using target-derived oracle selection as deployment evidence
hiding legalizer, selector or EDA-response cost
combining different budget points into one unconditional SOTA claim

boundary: Frozen planning configuration only; no inference-budget or SOTA claim exists before measured reports complete.
